head: 4f8b5554b
method: Full meaning-based sweep: every active FR/SC/acceptance scenario of specs 001 and 002 read against the implementing function, with file:line evidence. Branch delta: git diff origin/unstable.. -- components/dispatcher/src (specs/** and components/interfaces unchanged). Citation counting was not used (the component cites 4 of 120 requirement ids).
frontmatter_note: spec_sync_* frontmatter left unchanged on purpose (a script re-stamps it); its 'clean' status predates this branch's src/** changes.

branch_commits.effect: lookup_async keeps read pin across promote_and_serve; SSD evictor dm.remove before mt.remove
copy_gpu_to_memory_completed keeps live slot on AlreadyExists
populate releases slot on post-reserve failure

specs.title: Dispatcher Cache Interface (Memory-Tier Architecture)

drifted.spec_text: For SSD promotion paths the copy completes synchronously and a null stream is returned. / When a `batch_lookup` cold promotion loses the `IMemoryTier::insert` race
drifted.actual: lookup_async holds the dm.lookup read pin across promote_and_serve and maps AlreadyExists to serve_concurrently_promoted

drifted.spec_text: No memory-tier operation is needed (the entry was already evicted from DRAM).
drifted.actual: dm.remove first; on failure skip; then mt.remove; then emit Removed and free extent
populate calls release_memory on gpu-unbound, D2H error and sync error

drifted.spec_text: finalizes the entry after the async copies complete, transitioning it to a resident `MemoryTier` entry (design invariant P10).
drifted.actual: on AlreadyExists frees the slot only if the existing entry provably does not reference it

drifted.spec_text: whenever an entry is evicted from the memory-tier by `evict_for_space` / (or `Removed` on transition failure)
drifted.actual: MT evictor and SSD evictor also emit through EvictionSender, drops counted; MT evictor emits nothing on transition failure; Removed only from SSD evictor

drifted.spec_text: by calling `IMemoryTier::evict_next()` ... via `convert_memory_tier_to_block`. If the transition fails (write-through not complete), the entry is removed from the dispatch map entirely.
drifted.actual: oldest_keys + try_evict_to_block; on any failure incl. ActiveReferences calls mt.remove unconditionally then dm.remove (refused when pinned) -> dangling MemoryTier pointer

drifted.spec_text: MUST re-insert the entry into the memory-tier and re-register it as a MemoryTier entry
drifted.actual: no-drives promote_and_serve calls create_memory_tier_entry on an existing entry (AlreadyExists, ignored) and release_write without a write ref; entry stays BlockDevice, slot orphaned

drifted.requirement: FR-019 / US-9 AS1 / Q&A / Key Entities
drifted.spec_text: The fallback path (ring-buffer `pipelined_ssd_to_gpu`) is used when the memory-tier pool is not CUDA-pinned/SPDK-registered.
drifted.actual: no pipelined_ssd_to_gpu exists; pipelined_ssd_to_gpu_zero_copy is used only by serve_cold_staged

drifted.spec_text: All per-device streams MUST be destroyed during `shutdown()`.
drifted.actual: DEVICE_STREAMS entries live until process exit; shutdown destroys warm_stream and PipelineRing only

drifted.spec_text: the memory-tier slot is freed first, then the dispatch-map entry is removed
drifted.actual: dm.remove first, then mt.remove, then remove_extent

drifted.spec_text: reserves refused because the key was already cached
drifted.actual: incremented in evict_and_insert, so load-path concurrent-promotion losers are counted too
copy_gpu_to_memory_async (memcpy_d2h_async on store stream) + stream_synchronize; no non-test dma_copy_to_host call

partially_implemented.actual: integrity-check sync/set_checksum failure frees slot but leaves the new dispatch-map entry write-locked and dangling; downgrade_reference failure leaves it write-locked
BackgroundEvictor receives a one-time clone of eviction_tx at initialize(); both servers create the channel after initialize, so the SSD evictor never emits or counts

partially_implemented.requirement: FR-051 (+FR-036 after backfill) batch_lookup cold pin
partially_implemented.actual: batch_lookup releases the classification pin on BlockDevice before evict_and_insert/NVMe read/promote; same race the cold-pin repair closed for lookup_async

not_verifiable: Edge case: write-ref downgrade allows concurrent lookup

specs.title: Serving-Tier Attribution (`served_by`)

drifted.spec_text: every key whose copy was in flight is attributed `ERROR` and none is reported as a hit
drifted.actual: warm batched stream_synchronize failure is only logged; results stay Ok and tier stays Dram

drifted.spec_text: all of its sub-paths — pooled, inline fallback, no-drives, and staging
drifted.actual: inline fallback removed; sub-paths are scatter-gather, no-drives, staging

drifted.spec_text: Each attribution value MUST have a test that fails if that value is mis-assigned, in both dispatchers.
drifted.actual: value-specific assertions only for Dram and Miss

notes: FR-028 evidenced for this branch's repairs only
FR-029 integrity-check: mocks compile under the feature; no evidence the suite is run under it

unspecced.feature: remove of pinned/write-locked entry returns KeyNotFound; Timeout never returned

conflicts.summary: clear_memory_tier frees slot without pin check
pipelined_ssd_to_gpu_zero_copy called fallback but is the staging primitive
warm-sync failure semantics unspecified in 001, ERROR required by 002, code does neither
